_readme: Seed question set for the Engineer eval harness (docs/ENGINEER_NORTH_STAR.md §4). Everything downstream — judge calibration, variant wins, trap coverage — runs through these questions, so a hole here is a hole in every measurement. DRAFTED BY AI 2026-08-13; Jordan owes a founder pass before the first calibration session. archetypes: direction (corner-phase complaint wanting a change), condition (conditions changed, what now), tyre, theory (mechanism recall), tradeoff (KB pushes both ways — answer must hold both), net (change-first: what happens if I do X), plain (novice phrasing), trap-needs-data (correct answer admits it can't see logged data), trap-kb-silent (outside the corpus — must label honestly), trap-false-premise (question asserts wrong physics), trap-change-nothing (correct answer is don't change anything), trap-invented-number (invites a magnitude nothing in the corpus forces).
